title: [#36] Zig Roadmap 2024 - Andrew Kelley
summary: Andrew Kelley's 2024 Zig roadmap talk, followed by a Q&A, covers the language's priorities and the state of the project. Topics include compilation speed, moving off LLVM toward a self-hosted toolchain, async, and the path to 1.0.
why: HN points to it as the authoritative source on Zig's direction, especially why async was removed and why the toolchain is changing.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
